title: HIP BCH syndrome prototype
description:
Implement and evaluate a HIP/ROCm batch BCH syndrome-evaluation prototype.

## Background

BCH syndrome evaluation is highly parallel across codewords and syndrome points. The prototype keeps Berlekamp-Massey and Chien search on CPU unless evidence shows they dominate, while proving exact syndrome equivalence and measuring speed against the best current production CPU path.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] GPU GF($2^m$) log/exp table support covers $m \le 16$ for DVB-T2 short and normal BCH configurations.
- [hard] HIP Horner syndrome kernel computes one `(codeword, syndrome_index)` result per thread with exact integer arithmetic.
- [hard] Safe Rust wrappers and BCH integration are feature-gated behind `hip`; default workspace builds succeed without ROCm.
- [hard] CPU/GPU correctness fixtures cover small BCH, DVB-T2 short, and DVB-T2 normal with exact syndrome equality.
- [hard] GPU BCH syndrome evaluation is at least 5x faster than the best existing production CPU path at the selected design workload.
